basis: 28 reels listed with views, out of 2,252 posts (3 pinned, 1 posted minutes before the look). Covers read for 25. Caption and counters read for 9. Still frames for 2. Sound and spoken words not checked. Views are not adjusted for a reel's age. Groups hold 2 to 9 reels. Every reading below is a lead to test, not a rule.

works.title: A task with a return date
works.numbers: Six reels give the viewer something to do and a time to come back. Three sit near 300K, like the rest of the page. Three reached 923K, 1.0M and 1.7M: that is 3 of the 4 recent reels at 3x the median or more.
works.reading: It does not always work, but when this page spikes, this is usually the kind. In the 3 read closely, comments per view are 0.4% to 2.4%; in the 4 skits read closely, 0.02% to 0.05%. The biggest of the three opens on a secrecy hook ("Don't tell anyone"), which we would not use. The other two are a 24-hour test and a dated practice, so a plain version did reach about 1M here.

works.title: The Universe as a character
works.numbers: 9 of 28 reels are a two-role "POV" skit. Median 328K, close to the page's 304K. One is pinned at 8.3M and one recent reached 1.3M.
works.reading: This is the page's house format: quick to repeat, recognisable at once, steady. It holds the middle; it is not where most of the recent spikes came from.

weak.title: Bold claims to a mic
weak.numbers: "Lazy people manifest faster" 248K, "Your ex is the reason" 271K, "5 rules" 341K. Median of the group 260K, under the page's 304K. The same set-up is pinned at 12.3M.
weak.reading: Lowest group among the recent reels. Their captions were not read, so the reason is not known.

weak.title: Some skits fall well below the others
weak.numbers: "Where is my soft life?" 160K, "Nobody believes in me" 177K, "I want a million dollars" 186K.
weak.reading: Not explained by the cover: "I want a million dollars" sits at 186K while the very similar "I asked for MORE money" reached 1.3M. The one low skit read closely has the lowest share rate seen, 0.57% of views against 1.4% to 4.6% in the other eight. The difference is probably inside the reel, which needs the transcript.

weak.title: Part 2 of a list
weak.reading: Two reels only. The sequel reached fewer people than the first.

combine.title: One concept the pieces add up to
combine.text: A named character answers the viewer's wish (the skit), sets a small task with a deadline (the task reels), and the viewer reports back in comments. Her reels use one or two of these three parts; none of the ones looked at today uses all three together.
combine.for_us: Tarot Talk's 2027 series already has the character (the saarthi who drives your year). Add the task and the date: find your driver number, comment it, come back on 1 January.

growing.text: Not known yet. Views were read three times within about 16 minutes, which only shows the newest reels still moving. A reel that keeps growing weeks later can only be seen by reading the page again on other days.
growing.next: Read the reels grid once a day for a week. The dashboard will then show which reels are still gaining.

best.why: Best seen among the 28 listed, and pinned by her. A promise with a clock in it, on money, said straight to camera. Its caption sells her paid 11-day programme, so the reel she keeps on top is also a sales page.
Pinned by her. The house skit, with pain as the wish. 108 seconds, the longest reel read.
Pinned by her. A "signs you are..." list with a hold-back ("esp the last one"). The only list of this kind among the 28 seen.
Best of the recent reels. Three asks: stay to the end, send it to yourself, come back in 7 days. 40.7K comments. Opens on a secrecy hook.

shapes.name: Two-role skit
shapes.structure: One fixed line on screen for the whole reel naming the wish. Role A asks. Role B, a named character, answers with a twist. Captions on every line.
shapes.ours: Fixed line: "Mulank same. Saal alag?" Passenger asks why this year feels different; the saarthi answers.

shapes.name: The timed promise
shapes.structure: Hook names a length of time and what the viewer will know at the end of it.
shapes.ours: "60 second mein jaaniye, aapka 2027 kaun chala raha hai." Promise knowledge, never an outcome. On this page a clock in the hook gave mixed results.

shapes.name: Test it and report back
shapes.structure: One small thing to try, a deadline, and an invitation to come back and say what happened.
shapes.ours: "Aaj apna driver number nikaaliye. Kal bataiye, kya yeh aapke saal jaisa lagta hai?"

shapes.name: Do / don't columns
shapes.structure: Two columns on screen, ticks and crosses, one pair per beat.
shapes.ours: "Driver 7 ka saal: yeh kijiye / yeh mat kijiye." One driver per reel, or one theme with all nine.

shapes.name: The date anchor
shapes.structure: A practice tied to one calendar moment, with "save and come back".
shapes.ours: 31 December closing and 1 January opening. Keep it a reflection, not a ritual that "must" be done.

shapes.name: "This video found you"
shapes.from: "The Universe shows you this video 12 hours before it happens"
shapes.structure: Tells the viewer that seeing the reel is itself a sign or a prediction.
shapes.ours: Do not use. It is a false prophecy: the reel reaches people by the feed, not by fate. Second-highest group here (median 499K, 2 reels), which is exactly why it needs a clear no.

shapes.name: "Send it to yourself"
shapes.structure: Asks the viewer to share the reel to their own chat as part of a ritual.
shapes.ours: Do not use. It raises the share counter without anyone recommending the reel. Ask for a real send instead: "apne same-mulank dost ko bhejiye".

shapes.name: Secrecy and pressure hooks
shapes.from: "Don't tell anyone", "Don't fall asleep without saying this", "never be poor again"
shapes.structure: Secrecy, a threat of missing out, or a guaranteed result.
shapes.ours: Do not use. These break Tarot Talk's honesty rules: no fear, no guaranteed outcome.

notproven.title: "Money topics do better"
notproven.numbers: 10 of the 25 covers read are about money, so it is her main subject. But the money reels that are not pinned have a median of 303K against 328K for the rest, and 3 of the 4 recent hits are not about money.

notproven.title: "A clock in the hook does better"
notproven.numbers: Hooks that name a time: 12.3M (pinned), 1.0M, 923K, 691K, but also 311K, 301K and 252K.
notproven.reading: Mixed. Some of her best and some of her ordinary reels use it.
